data_objects.notes: The f, e, and x feature families are anonymous numeric columns.

data_objects.name: loan_labels

data_objects.name: public_tuning_artifact_bundle
data_objects.meaning: Directory of timestamped public artifact groups containing scene-level JSONL records, compact JSON state, text reports, and run-level summaries.
data_objects.notes: File presence varies by timestamped group; the bundle is not row-aligned with features.csv.

structure.description: features.csv and label.csv align by the composite key (time, bizcode); both key columns should be retained when joining.
The feature matrix has 100 source columns: two keys plus the complete f0-f66, e1-e11, and x0-x19 families.
The carisk HTML and timestamped artifact bundle are supporting public objects with no declared row-level key to the feature and label tables.

uncertainties: The public feature matrix does not define the business meaning or units of the anonymous f, e, and x columns.
The meaning of the binary label's positive class is not declared in the tabular headers.
The timestamped artifact groups are heterogeneous and some expected file types are absent from individual groups.
annotation_notes: High-dimensional regular feature families are grouped; all ordinary columns are listed separately.
The public tuning directory is described only at the bundle/file-role level, without exposing recorded outcomes.
